# Database Schema Reference {#sec-appendix-schema}

The complete table inventory of a PhyloTrace `.db`, grouped by owner
(@sec-database). DDL is quoted from the source; the pyMLST-owned tables are
created by pyMLST at typing time and described rather than quoted.

## pyMLST-owned core

Created by the typing engine (@sec-tech-typing); the analytical backbone.

| Table | Key columns | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `mlst` | `souche`, `gene`, `seqid` | The profile, long. `souche` is the isolate (aliased `isolate` in queries); `ref` is the synthetic seed row. |
| `sequences` | `id`, `sequence` | Allele DNA; `id` is a **global** sequence id, not a per-locus allele number. |
| `hashes` | `id`, `sha256` | Portable allele identity (maintained by `hash_database()`). |
| `mlst_type` | species, scheme | The scheme's organism/type. |
| `scheme_overview` | locus count, seed genome, cluster distance | Published scheme metadata, cached at download. |

## PhyloTrace result tables

Keyed on `isolate`, created lazily on first write.

```{.sql filename="app/logic/genome_hash.R"}
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS genome_hashes (
  isolate TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  genome_digest TEXT NOT NULL,    -- GA4GH sha512t24u over normalized contigs
  file_sha256 TEXT, algorithm TEXT NOT NULL,
  n_contigs INTEGER, total_length INTEGER, file_bytes INTEGER, hashed_at TEXT
)
```

```{.sql filename="app/logic/amr.R"}
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS amr_results (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, isolate TEXT,
  gene_symbol TEXT, sequence_name TEXT,
  element_type TEXT, element_subtype TEXT, class TEXT, subclass TEXT,
  method TEXT, pct_coverage REAL, pct_identity REAL,
  contig TEXT, start INTEGER, stop INTEGER, strand TEXT,
  ref_accession TEXT, ref_name TEXT, organism TEXT, point_mutations INTEGER,
  identity_threshold REAL,
  abritamr_version TEXT, amrfinder_version TEXT, amrfinder_db_version TEXT,
  called_at TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS amr_summary (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, isolate TEXT,
  section TEXT, drug_class TEXT, genes TEXT, called_at TEXT
)
```

`typing_provenance` (`app/logic/provenance.R`) is one wide row per isolate keyed
on `isolate`, recording the assembly digest and measures; the cgMLST scheme
(`cg_*`), classical scheme (`cla_*`) and AMR (`amr_*`) context; completeness
metrics; and the tool versions `pymlst_version`, `blat_version`, `mafft_version`.
The scheme columns are denormalized snapshots (@sec-tech-typing-provenance).

`classical_mlst` stores the per-isolate classical 7-gene call; `metadata` is the
dynamic, GenEpiO-aligned isolate field set (@sec-db-metadata) whose columns vary
and are labelled/typed by `field_labels.R`/`field_types.R`.

## PhyloTrace app tables (`phylotrace_*`)

The app's own state, riding inside the database (@sec-arch-state).

```{.sql filename="app/logic/analysis_store.R"}
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS phylotrace_meta ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS phylotrace_analyses (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT,
  created TEXT NOT NULL, modified TEXT NOT NULL,
  isolate_selection TEXT, isolate_universe TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS phylotrace_plots (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, analysis_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL, plot_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  inputs_json TEXT, thumb_b64 TEXT, created TEXT NOT NULL, modified TEXT NOT NULL
)
```

```{.sql filename="app/logic/custom_fields.R"}
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS phylotrace_custom_fields (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, type TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT, levels TEXT, position INTEGER,
  created TEXT NOT NULL, modified TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS phylotrace_custom_values (
  field_id INTEGER NOT NULL, isolate TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (field_id, isolate)
)
```

`phylotrace_sources` (`app/logic/db_sources.R`) registers imported peers and
their stable source labels, keyed on the peer's `uuid`.

## Staging tables (`imported_*`)

A peer's imported profiles, quarantined and read only by the distance path
(@sec-tech-interop-staging). Never touch `mlst`/`sequences`/`hashes`/`metadata`.

```{.sql filename="app/logic/db_staging.R"}
CREATE TABLE imported_sets (
  set_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, source_file TEXT,
  imported_at TEXT, value_kind TEXT, n_isolates INTEGER, n_loci INTEGER,
  shared_allele_rate REAL, has_sequences INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE TABLE imported_profiles (
  set_id INTEGER NOT NULL, isolate TEXT NOT NULL, gene TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (set_id, isolate, gene)
);
CREATE TABLE imported_sequences ( hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sequence TEXT NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE imported_metadata (
  set_id INTEGER NOT NULL, isolate TEXT NOT NULL, field TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (set_id, isolate, field)
)
```

## Keys, indexes and portability

- **Keying** — every PhyloTrace table keys on `isolate`; only pyMLST's `mlst` uses
  `souche` (@sec-db-key).
- **Indexes** — an export replays the source's DDL verbatim from `sqlite_master`
  so `mlst`'s primary key, its `seqid → sequences.id` foreign key and its `ix_*`
  indexes survive; import creates transient indexes (e.g. `pt_import_ix_*`) to
  speed the merge (@sec-tech-interop).
- **Portability** — pyMLST core + `phylotrace_*` + result tables travel with the
  file; `imported_*` are local staging and are not required by a peer.
